messages:
alex-cs: Heads-up — Escalation from AcmeCorp (EU tenant). They say they issued a delete via our API but objects still visible and they were billed for tokens after deletion. Created ticket INC-7842. Details pasted below.

incident-bot: Ticket INC-7842 created by alex-cs · priority: high · labels: compliance, customer-escalation

acme-rep: Repro steps from their side: 1) DELETE /v1/data/objects/obj_01F4xyz with our org API key -> 200 OK. 2) Immediately GET /v1/data/objects/obj_01F4xyz -> returns 200 + payload. 3) Billing shows token usage after the DELETE timestamp. They attached request IDs and timeframe.

alex-cs: They included KMS key id `eu-prod-key-7` and want KMS/HSM wrap/unwrap audit for the DEK, plus control-plane event timeline and confirmation of backups/snapshots. Also asked for signed attestation of erasure.

maya-sre: Assigning to infra/sre. First pass: check GC/tombstone lifecycle + replication/replay. @jia-eng can you check GC worker logs and the replication stream around 2026-03-10T12:00-12:10Z?

jia-eng: On it. Quick note: our GC is tombstone -> async decrypt DEK via KMS -> remove object from objectstore. If KMS unwrap times out, worker retries and there is a window where replication replay can restore state. Need object id and the customer's deployment type (hosted vs dedicated).

alex-cs: Obj id: obj_01F4xyz. Customer on Hosted API (EU region) but has some traffic pinned to a dedicated pool for throughput. They say deletion was at 2026-03-10T12:05Z (their local log).

noah-legal: Legal needs an initial timeline for compliance: time of delete request, our attempted erasure, KMS errors, and whether any backups might contain the data. They want an attestation PDF and raw logs (redactions OK).

maya-sre: I pulled control plane timeline — our tombstone recorded at 2026-03-10T12:05:02Z. But replication to `eu-dedicated-3` shows a replay at 2026-03-10T12:08:10Z which re-applied an older seq. Suspect GC tried to call KMS and failed; the replay restored the object.

jia-eng: Found the GC error in logs — pasted below:

```text
2026-03-10T12:05:02Z gc-worker-3 INFO tombstone obj_01F4xyz
2026-03-10T12:05:03Z gc-worker-3 ERROR dek-access timeout for key eu-prod-key-7: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-10T12:05:04Z gc-worker-3 WARN retrying delete, backoff=2s
2026-03-10T12:08:10Z rep-sync ERROR apply-seq failed: tombstone overwritten by replay (seq 482913 -> 482912)
```

jia-eng: Summary — GC attempted to contact KMS to unwrap the per-object DEK, call timed out, worker retried. Meanwhile the replication stream replayed an older state that reintroduced object payload, which explains both visibility and post-delete billing.

maya-sre: Agreed. Next steps: (1) capture KMS/HSM audit entries (wrap/unwrap) for `eu-prod-key-7` between 12:00-12:15Z, (2) pull control-plane RPC traces for tombstone apply and replication events, (3) pause billing for token usage after 12:05 until we confirm final delete, (4) re-run a forced GC after KMS connectivity confirmed.

infra-oncall: I'll pull the KMS HSM audit and share a timeline. Quick Q for CS: does customer accept redacted HSM logs or do they insist on full binary artifact? Also need written consent to include any vendor-identifying details.

alex-cs: Customer prefers a signed attestation PDF + raw logs with PII/HSM-sensitive fields redacted. They also asked whether snapshots/backups may still contain the data and how long those retain.

noah-legal: We'll need the retention windows for control-plane logs, objectstore snapshots, and vendor backups as of 2026-03-10. Also provide current subprocessor list that could have touched the data.

acme-rep: ETA needed for attestation. They flagged this as a regulatory request.

jia-eng: Mitigation plan (internal steps to reproduce/fix):

```bash
# 1. temporarily disable replication replay for customer to prevent restore
./infractl replication set-policy --customer acmecorp --disable-replay

# 2. verify KMS key reachable
gcloud kms keys versions list --key eu-prod-key-7 --location europe-west1

# 3. force delete the object with GC tool (will attempt unwrap again)
./tools/gc_force_delete --obj obj_01F4xyz --force --confirm

# 4. verify removal
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/data/objects/obj_01F4xyz
# expect 404
```

jia-eng: I'll run this in a scheduled maintenance window after infra confirms KMS availability. Will capture stdout/stderr and include checksums of final confirmation events.

maya-sre: I'll gather KMS audit + control plane traces and post an initial packet to legal within ~4 hours. If KMS HSM vendor returns logs in a different format, infra-oncall will normalize.

infra-oncall: Confirmed — pulling KMS HSM wrap/unwrap entries now (request sent to vendor-ops). Also enumerating snapshot catalog for any pre-12Mar backups.

noah-legal: Provide: (A) attestation template we'll sign, (B) list of subprocessors as of 2026-03-10 (aws-eu-s3, cloudflare, google-kms, vendor-archiver-inc), (C) retention windows. We'll prepare a DP attestation PDF once we have the logs.

alex-cs: Customer agreed to pause billing for tokens after 2026-03-10T12:05Z until we confirm deletion. Please prioritize.

incident-bot: Escalation label added: compliance · incident severity: P1

acme-rep: Thank you — please confirm next update ETA.

alex-cs: Initial packet to legal + customer in ~4 hours, full attestation next business day. Will update this thread as items arrive. :thumbsup:
